sponsored.sum: Allows municipal commissions to use alternate lists for filling vacancies with resident and non-resident minority group members and women in order to achieve diversity in police departments.

sponsored.t: Permits the sealing of records of certain nonviolent misdemeanor or nonsexual misdemeanor criminal offenses
sponsored.sum: Permits the sealing of records of certain nonviolent misdemeanor or non-sexual misdemeanor criminal offenses; defines the term "eligible misdemeanor"; excludes certain misdemeanor offenses as eligible misdemeanors for the purposes of conditional sealing; lists certain eligibility requirements for sealing; provides an order granting sealing under this section shall restore the individual concerned, in the contemplation of the laws, to the status such individual occupied before the arrest or institution of criminal proceedings for the crime that was the subject of the sealing.
sponsored.fis: The state can anticipate additional revenue if this bill becomes law.

sponsored.t: Relates to imposing certain conditions on the approval of a charter school application
sponsored.sum: Imposes certain conditions on the approval of a charter school application for the conversion of an existing public school to a charter school.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York college debt repayment program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York college debt repayment program.

sponsored.t: Relates to caseload relief
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring limits on the number of cases a public defender may be assigned in any given year.

sponsored.t: Caps the amount of collectible rent increases due to major capital improvements at six percent of the legal regulated rent
sponsored.sum: Caps the amount of collectible rent increases due to major capital improvements at six percent of the legal regulated rent.

sponsored.t: Prohibits public officials from releasing sealed juvenile police records
sponsored.sum: Prohibits public officials from releasing sealed juvenile police records; makes such official misconduct a class A misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Provides for compensation for injury or death caused by the negligent entrustment of a firearm
sponsored.sum: Provides for compensation for injury or death caused by the negligent entrustment of a firearm.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the collection of rent arrearages accruing prior to the date of approval of an application for an adjustment in the legal regulated rent based upon a major capital improvement
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the collection of rent arrearages accruing prior to the date of approval of an application for an adjustment in the legal regulated rent based upon a major capital improvement.

sponsored.t: Raises the monetary value of damaged property that is considered criminal mischief or securities fraud
sponsored.sum: Raises the monetary value of damaged property that is considered criminal mischief or securities fraud.

sponsored.t: Creates minority and women-owned business enterprise regional advocates
sponsored.sum: Creates minority and women-owned business enterprise regional advocates; provides that the advocates will help ensure that municipal agencies comply with the provisions of law relating to minority and women-owned business enterprises.

sponsored.t: Establishes a healthy savings pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a healthy savings pilot program within three cities where those in the program can receive discounts on healthier food choices at grocery stores and supermarkets.

sponsored.t: Relates to burglary in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Relates to burglary in the second degree; adds language where the building is a dwelling which, at the time of the commission of the crime, is occupied by a person who is not a participant in the crime to what constitutes burglary in the second degree.

sponsored.t: Relates to the manner in which certain provisions of the correction law are enforced
sponsored.sum: Relates to the manner in which certain provisions of the correction law are enforced.
sponsored.fis: There may be a small increase in administrative costs to the Division of Human Rights because of an increase in the filing of complaints.

sponsored.t: Relates to the age requirement for voting in a primary election
sponsored.sum: Allows a U.S. citizen, who is seventeen years of age, to vote in a primary election, including presidential, if such citizen will turn eighteen by the date of the corresponding general election.

sponsored.t: Creates a middle income home ownership subsidy program
sponsored.sum: Creates a middle income home ownership subsidy program to assist persons with an income below the current median income for the city of New York with the purchase of a residence in an urban area.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of "direct relationship" for the purposes of article 23-A of the correction law regarding certain licensures and employment
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of "direct relationship" for the purposes of article 23-A of the correction law regarding licensures and employment of persons previously convicted of one or more criminal offenses.
sponsored.fis: Successful re-entry and re-integration of formerly incarcerated individ- uals will increase state revenues through the inclusion of thousands of able-bodied taxpayers to the state's workforce; additional savings to the state will be gained from a reduction in costs associated with reci- divism, re-incarceration and social services.

sponsored.t: Relates to conducting a study on various approaches to increasing broadband access within this state
sponsored.sum: Relates to conducting a study on various approaches to increasing broadband access within this state.
sponsored.fis: Some minor administrative costs to the Public Service Commission.

sponsored.t: Relates to the requirements of the annual report from the division of minority and women's business development
sponsored.sum: Relates to the requirements of the annual report from the division of minority and women's business development.

sponsored.t: Relates to crisis intervention training for police officers
sponsored.sum: Relates to crisis intervention training for police officers in any city having a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Prohibits warehousing of housing accommodations and harassment of tenants; provides penalties therefor
sponsored.sum: Provides that penalties may be levied against a person who intentionally withholds a housing accommodation from the market, including for the purpose of future co-operative conversion.

sponsored.t: Requires supportive housing to be disbursed throughout the boroughs of certain cities in proportion to the borough population
sponsored.sum: Requires, in cities having a population of one million or more, supportive housing be disbursed throughout the boroughs of such city in proportion to the borough population.

sponsored.t: Makes it an unlawful discriminatory practice for prospective employers to make certain inquiries relating to criminal convictions
sponsored.sum: Establishes it shall be an unlawful discriminatory practice for any prospective employer to make an inquiry about, or to act upon adversely to the individual involved based upon, any criminal conviction of such individual unless such employer first makes a conditional offer of employment to such individual.
sponsored.fis: Successful re-entry and re-integration of formerly incarcerated individ- uals will increase state revenues through the inclusion of thousands of able-bodied taxpaying citizens to the state's workforce; additional savings to the state will result from a reduction in costs associated with recidivism, re-incarceration and social services.

sponsored.t: Establishes a temporary commission to examine and review the degree of segregation in primary and secondary schools
sponsored.sum: Establishes a temporary commission to examine and review the degree and effect of segregation in primary and secondary schools and any correlation with school funding and the long-term impact of inadequate education on segregated students.

sponsored.t: Relates to special provisions for not-for-profit sales
sponsored.sum: Relates to special provisions for not-for-profit sales.

sponsored.t: Creates a domestic abuse hotline for teens
sponsored.sum: Creates a domestic abuse hotline for teens; requires all high schools within the state to conduct an assembly on domestic abuse.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York City Housing Authority Facilities Modernization Act (Part A); and provides for reporting on lead-based paint poisoning prevention (Part B)
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "New York City Housing Authority Facilities Modernization Act" which shall assist with the installation, demolition, construction, reconstruction, excavation, rehabilitation, renovation, and repair of projects contracted out by the New York City Housing Authority (Part A); relates to reporting on lead-based paint poisoning prevention (Part B).

sponsored.t: Requires all motor vehicle insurers to file annual detailed financial and claim data statements with the superintendent of financial services
sponsored.sum: Requires all motor vehicle insurers to file annual detailed financial and claim data statements with the superintendent of financial services; provides that all such statements shall be made available to the public.

sponsored.t: Approves major capital improvement rent increases and extends the length of time over which major capital improvement expenses may be recovered
sponsored.sum: Approves major capital improvement rent increases and extends the length of time over which major capital improvement expenses may be recovered.

sponsored.t: Creates a public umbilical cord blood banking program
sponsored.sum: Creates a public umbilical cord blood banking program within the department of health to promote public awareness of the potential benefits of public cord banking, to promote research into the uses of cord blood, and to facilitate pre-delivery arrangements for public banking of cord blood donations.

sponsored.t: Establishes certain rights for shareholders in limited-profit housing companies
sponsored.sum: Establishes certain rights for shareholders in limited-profit housing companies.

sponsored.t: Mandates that every owner of a cabaret establishment, but which is not a restaurant shall install security cameras
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Imette's Law"; mandates that every owner of a cabaret establishment, but which is not a restaurant, shall install security cameras at every entrance and exit of such establishment.

sponsored.t: Relates to acknowledging that the institution of slavery was an appalling tragedy in the history of this state
sponsored.sum: Relates to acknowledging that the institution of slavery was an appalling tragedy in the history of this state.

sponsored.t: Relates to officer-involved deaths and near deaths
sponsored.sum: Creates a board to review officer-involved deaths and near deaths.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a childhood education surcharge on the personal income tax for cities having a population of one million or more persons
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a childhood education surcharge on the personal income tax for cities having a population of one million or more persons.

sponsored.t: Provides for a deduction from personal income for adoption expenses
sponsored.sum: Provides for a deduction against personal gross income in an amount equal to fees, costs and expenses paid or incurred including legal fees and agency costs in connection with the adoption of a child.

sponsored.t: Requires two qualified psychiatrists to be employed by each school district
sponsored.sum: Requires two qualified psychiatrists to be employed by each school district to perform and coordinate the provision of mental health services in the public schools.

sponsored.t: Requires all forms issued to the public by the state include an optional question regarding veteran status
sponsored.sum: Requires all forms issued to the public by the state include an optional question regarding veteran status and whether the person completing the form would consent to the agency sharing their contact information with regards to resources available to veterans.

sponsored.t: Relates to training for police officers before allowing them to carry or use a firearm
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting police officers from carrying or using a firearm during any phase of the officer's official duties unless the officer has satisfactorily completed a course of training that meets or exceeds the minimum standards established by the municipal police training council.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of a court appointed advocate for animals
sponsored.sum: Relates to the creation of a court appointed advocate for animals.

sponsored.t: Modifies the effect of termination of criminal actions and proceedings against a minor
sponsored.sum: Provides for the expungement of certain records following the termination of criminal actions and proceedings against certain minors.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Omnibus Prevailing Wage Enforcement Act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Omnibus Prevailing Wage Enforcement Act"; creates the office of the prevailing wage fraud inspector general for increased vigilance in the effort to achieve prevailing wage enforcement; allows public authorities to require that successful bidders for public works jobs participate in a state-sponsored apprenticeship program; makes related provisions.
sponsored.fis: Would result in increased enforcement and penalty collection and addi- tional revenue due to the proper payment of wages.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring helicopters be equipped with flight recorders, cockpit voice recorders and terrain awareness and warning systems
sponsored.sum: Requires helicopters be equipped with flight recorders, cockpit voice recorders and terrain awareness and warning systems.

sponsored.t: Requires registration of general aviation aircrafts
sponsored.sum: Requires registration of general aviation aircrafts; aircrafts used for civil aviation; issuance of certificates of registration; proof of insurance.

sponsored.t: Relates to civil penalties on certain public utility companies, corporations or persons and the officers, agents and employees thereof
sponsored.sum: Increases civil penalties on certain combination gas and electric corporations that fail to comply with the public service law.

sponsored.t: Establishes certification procedures for the profession of nurse anesthesia
sponsored.sum: Establishes certification procedures for the profession of nurse anesthesia; provides for the issuance of a certification to practice as a certified registered nurse anesthetist upon the filing of an application, having a license as a registered professional nurse, having the appropriate educational requirements and paying the fifty dollar initial certification fee and the triennial thirty dollar registration fee.

sponsored.t: Requires probation, investigation and diagnostic assessment of certain juvenile delinquents with discernible handicapping conditions prior to dispositional hearings
sponsored.sum: Provides that prior to a dispositional hearing the judge shall order a probation investigation and a diagnostic assessment of a juvenile delinquent whom the court reasonably finds, on the record, to have a demonstrable need for a remediation of a discernible handicapping condition; allows judges to refer custody through various state agencies for placement into programs under protocol and funding provisions currently in existence.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting lessees the option to pay security deposits in installments
sponsored.sum: Relates to permitting lessees the option to pay security deposits in six or fewer equal installments.

sponsored.t: Directs state university trustees to promulgate and enforce a sweat-free code of conduct for the licensing and purchase of apparel at colleges of state university
sponsored.sum: Directs the state university trustees to promulgate and enforce a sweat-free code of conduct for the licensing and purchase of apparel at colleges and universities of the state university; requires provision in contracts with apparel manufacturers providing for the termination thereof if the manufacturer uses a sweatshop; requires that at least one member of the special task force on the apparel industry be a representative of the state university of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to forensic DNA testing and to requests for certain DNA test comparisons
sponsored.sum: Establishes the minimum period of time that forensic samples should be retained by investigating authorities; creates the state commission for the integrity of the criminal justice system, as an independent agency, and provides for such commission's powers and duties; relates to special fictitious name indictments; relates to requests for certain DNA test comparisons; relates to forensic DNA testing; relates to claims for unjust conviction and imprisonment; relates to DNA testing, data collection and record keeping; relates to DNA testing in felony cases.
sponsored.fis: The bill would result in increased costs to the state, primarily through the significant expansion of the state DNA identification index.

sponsored.t: Relates to the age requirement for voting in a primary election
sponsored.sum: Relates to the age requirement for voting in a primary election; provides that a person who is seventeen years of age at the time of a primary election and who will be eighteen years of age at the time of the general election for which such primary election is held, shall be eligible to vote in such primary election.

sponsored.t: Requires the use of body-worn cameras on certain correction officers
sponsored.sum: Requires the use of body-worn cameras on certain correction officers.

sponsored.t: Requires landlords to check state sex offender registry when leasing to a new tenant or on notice of sublet, and to notify tenants with children of certain listings
sponsored.sum: Requires landlords to check the state sex offender registry when leasing to a new tenant, subtenant or adult occupant, and to notify tenants with children under age sixteen of any listing of such tenant, subtenant or adult occupant as a level three sex offender; exempts landlord from any civil or criminal liability for damages for any discretionary decision to release relevant information pursuant to this section or for failing to release such information, unless it is shown the landlord acted with gross negligence or in bad faith.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring inspections for Legionnaires' disease in certain locations
sponsored.sum: Requires annual inspections in certain locations by the department of health for the presence of Legionnaires' disease.

sponsored.t: Relates to the compensation an attorney shall be entitled to for client representation through the bar association
sponsored.sum: Provides the amount of compensation an attorney shall receive from representing a client which was assigned to the attorney through the bar association; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires the disclosure of video footage related to the death of an incarcerated individual involving a correctional officer
sponsored.sum: Requires the disclosure of video footage related to the death of an incarcerated individual involving a correctional officer to the attorney general's office of special investigation.

sponsored.t: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study regarding ecological literacy and healthy living curriculum in schools, and to provide recommendations in a report
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study regarding ecological literacy and healthy living curriculum in schools, and to provide recommendations in a report.

sponsored.t: Provides voice communication service to incarcerated people at no cost; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing voice communication services to incarcerated individuals in state correctional facilities at no cost.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring training for teachers and administrators in the area of childhood trauma
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring training for teachers and administrators in the area of childhood trauma after January 1, 2026.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "health insurance preauthorization disclosure act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "health insurance preauthorization disclosure act"; requires health insurance companies to provide participating health care providers with a list of health care treatments and services that require preauthorization from the health insurance company.

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements of motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires certain motor vehicles to have rear passenger detection warning systems.

sponsored.t: Relates to taxpayers affected by a federal government shutdown
sponsored.sum: Relates to taxpayers affected by a federal government shutdown by granting an extension for those who are furloughed and expediting their tax refunds.

sponsored.t: Defines blighted properties and areas; repealer
sponsored.sum: Defines blighted properties and areas.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting wind turbines from being located in a certain area of the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Prohibits wind turbines from being located within 1500 feet of a residential area or commercial shopping district within the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to the discovery provisions applicable to juvenile delinquency proceedings in family court; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the discovery provisions applicable to juvenile delinquency proceedings in family court with regard to the timing of discovery, disclosure prior to certain guilty pleas, DNA evidence, court orders, and the admissibility of discovery.

sponsored.t: Provides final discipline authority over civilian complaints to the civilian complaint review board
sponsored.sum: Provides final discipline authority over civilian complaints to the civilian complaint review board; creates a hearing officer and adjudicative body for such complaint review board.

sponsored.t: Relates to the regulation and licensing of on-demand pay providers
sponsored.sum: Relates to the regulation and licensing of employer-integrated and non-verified on-demand pay providers.

sponsored.t: Allows an action for unlawful discriminatory practice to be brought within three years after dismissal for administrative convenience
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the institution of a suit in any court of competent jurisdiction alleging a violation of the human rights law for a period of three years after the dismissal of a complaint for administrative convenience by the division of human rights.

sponsored.t: Authorizes appointment of alternate rent guidelines board members in the city of New York, counties outside the city, towns, and villages
sponsored.sum: Provides for the appointment of three alternates on rent guideline boards; one alternate shall represent tenants, one shall represent owners of property and one shall be a public representative; alternates shall be permitted to participate in all proceedings of the board as non-voting members; an alternate shall only participate as a voting member of the board and be paid when a member, representing the same interest as the alternate, is unable to fulfill their duties on the board; applies to the city of New York, counties outside the city, towns and villages.

sponsored.t: Requires cultural awareness and competence training for all medical professionals as part of their licensing requirements; public ed program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Requires cultural awareness and competence training for all medical professionals as part of their licensing requirements; requires biennial training in the non-discriminatory provision of medical services for physicians, physician assistants, dentists, dental hygienists, registered and licensed practical nurses, podiatrists, and optometrists; authorizes the department of education to develop the training in consultation with the department of health and other experts; provides for documentation and exemption from the requirements; provides for a public education program on minority health; appropriates $100,000 therefor.

sponsored.t: Provides for the confidentiality, sealing and expungement of juvenile delinquency records; repealer
sponsored.sum: Provides for the confidentiality, sealing and expungement of juvenile delinquency records including providing notice to the respondent and attorney for the child when such acts of the court are ordered.

sponsored.t: Creates a tax credit for employment of persons on probation or parole
sponsored.sum: Creates a tax credit for employment of persons on probation or parole.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "criminal forfeiture process act"; repealer
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "criminal forfeiture process act" to replace the process for the criminal forfeiture of certain property in certain instances.

sponsored.t: Prohibits members of the state police, police officers, and peace officers from intentionally covering their badges
sponsored.sum: Prohibits members of the state police, police officers, and peace officers from intentionally covering their badges.

sponsored.t: Relates to excused absence of a public employee for mental health purposes
sponsored.sum: Relates to excused absence of a public employee for mental health purposes.

sponsored.t: Requires businesses which provide for someone to spoof a telephone number to keep certain records
sponsored.sum: Requires businesses which provide for someone to spoof a telephone number to keep records of the phone calls placed with their services.

sponsored.t: Expands health care plan contract coverage for any health care provider for one hundred twenty days after the termination of such contract
sponsored.sum: Expands health care plan contract coverage for any health care provider for one hundred twenty days after the termination of such contract.

sponsored.t: Prevents interactive computer service providers from knowingly or negligently promoting developed content that is dangerous or otherwise injurious to minors
sponsored.sum: Prevents interactive computer service providers from knowingly or negligently promoting developed content that is dangerous or otherwise injurious to minors; assesses a civil penalty to social media networks that knowingly or negligently promote such content.

sponsored.t: Provides for disclosing to a parent the personal information and content about a minor collected by an operator of an internet platform
sponsored.sum: Discloses to a parent the personal information and content about a minor collected by an operator of an internet platform when a parent requests such information.

sponsored.t: Relates to police officer and peace officer hiring and transfers
sponsored.sum: Relates to police officer and peace officer hiring and transfers; requires police agencies review any possible internal files of police misconduct and complaints as well as pending criminal charges before hiring or allowing for a transfer.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York baby opportunity fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York baby opportunity fund which deposits $1,000 into an account managed by the state comptroller to be available to eligible children when they reach the age of 18; provides such funds be used for education costs, the purchase of real estate, or entrepreneurship.

sponsored.t: Creates the office of expungement and automatic sealing
sponsored.sum: Creates the office of expungement and automatic sealing within the division of criminal justice services to oversee the sealing and expungement of certain convictions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the rights of patients to receive medical information in an understandable format
sponsored.sum: Relates to the rights of patients to receive medical information in an understandable format; provides that such information and documents shall avoid the use of medical terminology and instead use words with common and everyday meanings to facilitate understandability.

sponsored.t: Provides for the New York state of health to help veterans ascertain their eligibility for health care through the department of veterans affairs
sponsored.sum: Provides for the New York state of health to help veterans ascertain their eligibility for health care through the department of veterans affairs.

sponsored.t: Relates to the disclosure of law enforcement disciplinary records
sponsored.sum: Requires the disclosure of certain information when an agency responds to a request for law enforcement disciplinary records, including information a victim alleges regarding sexual misconduct.

sponsored.t: Prohibits discrimination during the appraisal of real property
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination during the appraisal of real property because of the age, race, creed, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, military status, sex, disability, predisposing genetic characteristics, familial status, marital status or status as a victim of domestic violence.

sponsored.t: Establishes a program for the sharing of veteran contact information
sponsored.sum: Establishes a program for the sharing of veteran contact information.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring disclosure of types of replacement parts used in automobile collision repairs
sponsored.sum: Requires motor vehicle repair shops to disclose types of replacement parts used in automobile collision repairs and provides a disclosure form to be signed by the owner consenting to the use of any such parts; forbids use of any other parts except new original equipment manufacturer parts on any vehicle during the first year of its manufacture and for the two years following.
sponsored.fis: None to the state or localities.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Velmanette Montgomery YouthBuild act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Velmanette Montgomery YouthBuild act"; sets program requirements; authorizes grants to eligible YouthBuild participants; establishes application requirements.

sponsored.t: Designates certain emergency and public safety dispatchers and operators as first responders
sponsored.sum: Designates certain emergency and public safety dispatchers and operators as first responders.

sponsored.t: Relates to undisposed cases
sponsored.sum: Provides that when the division of criminal justice services conducts a search of its criminal history records and returns a report thereon, all references to undisposed cases shall be excluded.

sponsored.t: Relates to collective bargaining rights for college athletes and authorizes the public employment relations board to exercise jurisdiction over collective bargaining matters
sponsored.sum: Relates to collective bargaining rights for college athletes; authorizes the public employment relations board to exercise jurisdiction over institutions of higher education and college student athlete employees of such institutions in relation to all collective bargaining matters.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the Educational Rights Transparency for New York Families Act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the Educational Rights Transparency for New York Families Act, to establish standards for resource based educational rights of students within the state and implement a system of self-assessment and reporting by schools and school districts.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing state disaster emergency requirements for homeless shelters
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing state disaster emergency requirements for homeless shelters including placement of individuals and families in shelters and reporting of infections related to the emergency.
sponsored.fis: One hundred percent of the costs associated with the implementation of this title shall be reimbursed by the state, minus any federal funds that can be applied to such expenditures.

sponsored.t: Preserves the ability to appeal a violation of a defendant's right to make a statement personally at sentencing
sponsored.sum: Preserves the ability to appeal a violation of a defendant's right to make a statement personally at sentencing notwithstanding a defendant signed an otherwise valid waiver of appeal.

sponsored.t: Relates to the timely scheduling of criminal trials
sponsored.sum: Relates to the timely scheduling of criminal trials.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a tax deduction for certain capital gains
sponsored.sum: Creates a tax deduction for certain capital gains.

sponsored.t: Includes solicitation or facilitation of certain crimes as a specified offense for the purposes of a hate crime
sponsored.sum: Includes solicitation or facilitation of certain crimes as a specified offense for the purposes of a hate crime.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state youth sports initiative grants fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state youth sports initiative grants fund under the commissioner of children and family services.

sponsored.t: Relates to transportation management brokers
sponsored.sum: Relates to transportation management brokers; provides that transportation management brokers are no longer required to manage the transportation services for Medicaid beneficiaries.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the COVID-19 recovery local employment tax credit program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the COVID-19 recovery local employment tax credit program to provide tax incentives to employers for employing local employees in full-time or part-time positions in the two years following the conclusion of the state disaster emergency declared pursuant to executive order two hundred two.

sponsored.t: Provides for emergency evacuation plans and safe spaces for vulnerable occupants
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency evacuation plans for vulnerable occupants in all residential occupancies; requires designated safe spaces equipped with emergency medical supplies in buildings greater than 125 feet (38 100 mm) in height; provides for a voluntary registry to meet the special needs of occupants who require assistance during evacuations or other emergency situations.

sponsored.t: Creates an identification card program for local correctional facilities; and relates to issuance of and waiver of fees for identification cards issued pursuant to certain identification card programs
sponsored.sum: Creates an identification card program for incarcerated individuals in local correctional facilities; requires such identification cards to be identical to non-driver identification cards issued to the general public; waives fees for such identification cards.

sponsored.t: Provides insurance coverage for cranial prostheses
sponsored.sum: Provides insurance coverage for cranial prostheses for a diagnosed health condition, chronic illness, or injury.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibitions on rebating and discrimination in rates and payments under insurance policies
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibitions on rebating and discrimination in rates and payments under insurance policies; provides that certain services shall not be considered to be an inducement or rebate unless the superintendent determines that the offer and sale of such services constituted the sole reason for the purchase of such insurance policy.

sponsored.t: Waives the state application fee for all civil service examinations for all veterans
sponsored.sum: Waives the state application fee for all civil service examinations for all veterans.

sponsored.t: Relates to timely release of principals on bail
sponsored.sum: Requires persons held in custody to be released immediately upon posting bail; requires use and acceptance of electronic signatures and records to effectuate communications relating to posting bail.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a presumption of eligibility for housing and temporary shelter placement for those who lost employment due to a non-essential business shutdown
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a presumption of eligibility for housing and temporary shelter placement for those who lost employment due to a non-essential business shutdown.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York children's COVID-19 fund program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York COVID-19 children's fund program to provide assistance to children whose parent, custodian, legal guardian, or related adult household member died as a result of contracting COVID-19, regardless of immigration status of such children.

sponsored.t: Relates to breath chemical tests for the purpose of determining the alcoholic and/or drug content of the blood
sponsored.sum: Requires a police officer to provide the consequences of refusal to submit to a chemical test for the purpose of determining the alcoholic and/or drug content of the blood, both orally and in writing in such person's preferred language, and by an interpreter if necessary.

sponsored.t: Institutes a moratorium on the closure of hospitals during a pandemic
sponsored.sum: Institutes a moratorium on the closure of hospitals during a state of emergency which was declared due to a pandemic.

sponsored.t: Removes labor market attachment requirements for certain disability cases
sponsored.sum: Removes labor market attachment requirements for cases of permanent partial disability.

sponsored.t: Establishes a reentry services and treatment fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes a reentry services and treatment fund; establishes training requirements for peace officers related to mental illness and trauma informed care.
sponsored.fis: This bill will invest savings from reduced incarceration into services and treatment, which in turn will provide a benefit to the state of reduced future incarceration costs and safer streets.

sponsored.t: Relates to non-insurance benefits
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing non-insurance benefits or services to be offered as part of group life or group or blanket accident or health insurance policies.

sponsored.t: Establishes the interstate insurance product regulation compact to regulate certain insurance products among member states
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "Interstate insurance product regulation compact" to regulate certain insurance products among member states and to promote and protect the interest of consumers of individual and group annuity, life insurance, disability income and long-term care insurance products.
sponsored.fis: Having New York join the Compact would cause minimal or no fiscal impact to the state, since the Commission is fully operational and is being financed by product filing fees provided by the companies that are using the process.

sponsored.t: Relates to the redomestication of insurance companies
sponsored.sum: Amends the definition of redomestication of insurance companies to include the transfer from this state of the corporate domicile of a domestic company.

sponsored.t: Relates to paintless dent repair rate filing
sponsored.sum: Relates to paintless dent repair rate filing.

sponsored.t: Requires the county sheriff to oversee an annual jail staffing analysis and provide a report to the commission of corrections and community supervision
sponsored.sum: Requires the county sheriff to oversee an annual jail staffing analysis and provide a report to the commission of corrections and community supervision and give the public the opportunity to view the statistics of their local county jail.

sponsored.t: Requires insurance companies to provide detailed rationale for rate changes of certain state or municipal backed buildings
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance companies to provide detailed rationale and the formulation for rate changes of certain state or municipal backed buildings.

sponsored.t: Authorizes counties with a population of one million or more persons to use the alternative delivery method known as design-build contracts
sponsored.sum: Authorizes counties with a population of one million or more persons to undertake certain public works pursuant to project labor agreements; authorizes the use of the alternative delivery method known as design-build contracts; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Prohibits property/casualty insurers from discrimination
sponsored.sum: Prohibits property/casualty insurers from discriminating based on race, color, creed, national origin, disability, age, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, education background or educational level attained, employment status or occupation, income level, consumer credit information or score, ownership or interest in real property, location, type of residence, including but not limited to single-family home, multi-family home, apartment, housing subsidized by state and/or federal programs, or any other residence type, or any indication of a consumer's price elasticity of demand.

sponsored.t: Requires the chief administrator of the courts and the office of information technology services to develop a portal for the exchange of discovery in criminal cases
sponsored.sum: Requires the chief administrator of the courts and the office of information technology services to develop a portal for the exchange of discovery in criminal cases.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the establishment of permanent Covid-19 memorials and establishes a Covid-19 permanent memorial fund
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the establishment of permanent COVID-19 memorials; establishes a COVID-19 permanent memorial fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting certain cannabis related advertisements
sponsored.sum: Prohibits any cannabis related advertisements in establishments within a certain distance from schools; increases penalties for prohibited advertisement of tobacco and cannabis products; requires enforcement inspections.

sponsored.t: Designates certain zip codes as cease and desist zones
sponsored.sum: Designates certain zip codes within Bronx county and Mount Vernon in Westchester county as cease and desist zones.

sponsored.t: Sets hourly rates for persons representing certain persons in court or before a magistrate
sponsored.sum: Sets hourly rates for persons representing certain persons in court or before a magistrate.

sponsored.t: Provides for qualified mental health associates
sponsored.sum: Directs the office of mental health to establish programs for the training and development of persons capable of providing coaching and support to individuals under treatment plans developed by licensed mental health practitioners, including but not limited to a process of issuing, either directly or through contract, credentials for qualified mental health associates.

sponsored.t: Establishes procedures to disassemble and dispose of guns purchased by local municipalities and law enforcement agencies through a gun buyback program
sponsored.sum: Establishes procedures to disassemble and dispose of guns, rifles and firearms purchased by local municipalities and law enforcement agencies through a gun buyback program, including the creation of a log and video recordings.

sponsored.t: Requires the state to enter into an agreement with the Rand Corporation to conduct a study of the impact the 2020 Discovery Reform legislation has had on the handling of criminal cases
sponsored.sum: Requires the state to enter into an agreement with the Rand Corporation to conduct a study of the impact of the 2020 Discovery Reform legislation enacted by Part HHH of chapter 56 of the laws of 2020 has had on the handling and disposition of criminal cases; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Relates to the formation of mutual holding companies by certain domestic mutual property/casualty insurers and the reorganization in connection therewith of a domestic mutual property/casualty insurer
sponsored.sum: Provides for the formation of mutual holding companies by certain domestic mutual property/casualty insurers and the reorganization in connection therewith of a domestic mutual property/casualty insurer into a domestic stock property/casualty insurer.

sponsored.t: Relates to the distribution of the foreign and alien fire insurance premium tax
sponsored.sum: Relates to the distribution of the foreign and alien fire insurance premium tax; provides amount received shall be distributed to the fire companies in proportion to the number of active members within each company.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding the authority to issue group annuity contracts
sponsored.sum: Relates to expanding the authority to issue group annuity contracts.

sponsored.t: Requires self supporting life insurance and annuity business policies; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires self-supporting life insurance and annuity business policies.

sponsored.t: Exempts private air ambulance services from insurance licensing and other requirements
sponsored.sum: Exempts private air ambulance services from insurance licensing and other requirements if the private ambulance service meets certain enumerated qualifications.

sponsored.t: Authorizes service charges for gap waivers
sponsored.sum: Authorizes service charges for gap waivers.

sponsored.t: Establishes patient safety and quality assurance measures regarding the distribution of patient-specific medication from an insurer-designated pharmacy
sponsored.sum: Establishes patient safety and quality assurance measures regarding the distribution of patient-specific medication from an insurer-designated pharmacy; prohibits certain "brown bagging" and "white bagging" policies regarding pharmacy provided medications.

sponsored.t: Modifies the interest rate within the standard nonforfeiture law for annuities
sponsored.sum: Reduces the minimum nonforfeiture interest rate for annuities from one percent to one half of one percent for annuities during the surrender charge period, and from one percent to fifteen hundredths of one percent during any contract period with no surrender charge.

sponsored.t: Increases the jurisdictional limit from $3,000 to $5,000 for justice courts and increases filing fees
sponsored.sum: Increases the jurisdictional limit from $3,000 to $5,000 for justice courts; increases filing fees.

sponsored.t: Relates to required terms for certain insurance contracts
sponsored.sum: Includes permissible payment methods, advance consent for direct payments, and annually providing the updated rate schedule as required terms for certain insurance contracts.

sponsored.t: Directs the state insurance fund to compensate licensed insurance producers for services provided to clients who obtain coverage through the fund
sponsored.sum: Directs the state insurance fund to compensate insurance brokers for services provided to clients who obtain coverage through the fund; establishes within the existing rate structure a factor to compensate licensed insurance producers for services provided to clients who obtain coverage through the fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to the hiring of consultants
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the superintendent of financial services to hire a consultant to assist with reviewing any rate or form filing submitted to the superintendent.

sponsored.t: Relates to continuing education for licensed persons and qualifications for independent adjusters
sponsored.sum: Relates to claims for loss or damage to real property; creates continuing education requirements for licensed persons and qualifications for public and independent adjusters; allows for a revocation of licenses with an opportunity to reapply for such licenses.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the imposition of penalties on subcontractors for failure to adhere to the standards for prompt, fair and equitable settlement of claims for health care and payments for health care services
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the imposition of penalties on subcontractors for failure to adhere to the standards for prompt, fair and equitable settlement of claims for health care and payments for health care services.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of financial services to conduct a study examining private flood insurance
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of financial services to conduct a study examining the increasing costs of insurance premiums, the lack of availability of insurance coverage for losses from flooding, and the possibility of supporting a private flood insurance market in the state.

sponsored.t: Provides for standardized health insurance contracts for small dental employers
sponsored.sum: Provides for standardized health insurance contracts for small dental employers who meet certain criteria.

sponsored.t: Relates to the requirement for policyholders to provide 30 days notice to withdraw from the state insurance fund
sponsored.sum: Relates to the requirement for policyholders to provide notice to withdraw from the state insurance fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to licensing requirements for bail bond agents
sponsored.sum: Relates to licensing requirements for bail bond agents; requires additional course instruction and other prerequisites to licensure.

sponsored.t: Expands authorization for certain exemptions from filing requirements
sponsored.sum: Expands authorization for certain exemptions from filing requirements.

sponsored.t: Relates to loss prevention programs
sponsored.sum: Authorizes insurers to provide no or low cost loss prevention programs to policyholders, pursuant to regulations.

sponsored.t: Relates to invoking coverage of a health insurance plan for long term care for an incapacitated individual
sponsored.sum: Allows for spouses and domestic partners to invoke coverage of a health insurance plan for long term care for an incapacitated individual.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring CPR and AED training by youth league coaches
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring CPR and AED training by youth league coaches; requires youth league coaches to be trained in adult and child CPR and the use of an automated external defibrillator; provides current coaches have one year from the effective date of the law to receive such training; provides that a person who is unable to complete a training due to a physical disability may coach as long as a person who has completed a training is present at all times.

sponsored.t: Requires any student graduating from a high school in New York state be provided with a voter registration form
sponsored.sum: Requires any student graduating from a high school in New York state be provided with a voter registration form.

sponsored.t: Relates to the revocation of certain licenses for the possession or sale of illicit cannabis in violation of the cannabis law
sponsored.sum: Provides for the revocation of licenses to sell cigarettes, tobacco products, alcohol and lottery tickets for the possession or sale of illicit cannabis in violation of the cannabis law.

sponsored.t: Requires a sworn affidavit stating the seller was informed of the fair market value of the property
sponsored.sum: Requires a sworn affidavit stating the seller was informed of the fair market value of the property which includes an estimate of the fair market value of the property be included in the real property transfer form.

sponsored.t: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Dwight Heavy D Myers Way"
sponsored.sum: Designates state route 22 between Lorraine Avenue and Lincoln Avenue in the city of Mount Vernon as the "Dwight 'Heavy D' Myers Way".

sponsored.t: Establishes a MWBE or SDVOBE subcontractor tax credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for contractors who award a subcontract to MWBE or SDVOBE subcontractors in furtherance of a state contract.

sponsored.t: Prohibits any person who owns or manages more than four rental units within the state from serving as a public member on a rent guidelines board
sponsored.sum: Prohibits any person who owns or manages more than four rental units within the state from serving as a public member on a rent guidelines board.

sponsored.t: Establishes the office of black male excellence
sponsored.sum: Establishes the office of black male excellence to analyze and provide recommendations regarding issues relating to black males including education, criminal justice, health, mental health, economic opportunity, employment, fatherhood, mentorship, violence, public safety, and quality of life.

sponsored.t: Allows for a modest increase in annual income to not disqualify someone from the excelsior scholarship
sponsored.sum: Allows for a modest increase in annual income, not greater than three percent per year, to not disqualify someone from the excelsior scholarship.

sponsored.t: Requires principals be informed of the physical address of the probation office where such principal must report and the telephone number for such office
sponsored.sum: Requires principals be informed of the physical address of the probation office where such principal must report and the telephone number for such office.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state lead-safe renovation, repair and painting act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "New York state lead-safe renovation, repair and painting act"; establishes standards for lead-safe renovation, repair and painting of residential properties; requires documentation of compliance with such standards.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the power authority to create the New York State small business development program
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the power authority to create the New York State small business development program.

sponsored.t: Relates to contingent fee rules for attorneys in claims or actions for medical, dental or podiatric malpractice
sponsored.sum: Updates contingent fee rules for attorneys in claims or actions for medical, dental or podiatric malpractice; permits applications for enhanced fees; permits plaintiffs to waive contingent retainer limitations.

sponsored.t: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of environmental conservation to conduct a study on food waste initiatives and to provide recommendations based on the study's findings
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of environmental conservation to conduct a study on food waste initiatives and to provide recommendations based on the study's findings.

sponsored.t: Directs the office of mental health to conduct a study on the effects of abuse suffered while incarcerated on formerly incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Directs the office of mental health to conduct a study on the effects of abuse suffered while incarcerated on formerly incarcerated individuals.

sponsored.t: Relates to protections for victims of real property theft
sponsored.sum: Relates to protections for victims of real property theft, providing for a rebuttable presumption that a purchaser or incumbrancer has notice of fraud or fraudulent intent in certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Establishes the construction insurance notification act (CINA)
sponsored.sum: Establishes the construction insurance notification act (CINA) requiring notification of governmental agencies and departments when certain construction insurance policies have lapsed or been canceled.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the certificate of insurance reliability act (CIRA)
sponsored.sum: Relates to requirements for and forms of certificates of insurance.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing funding for transitional programs for students from English-speaking Caribbean countries
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing funding for transitional programs for students from English-speaking Caribbean countries who are not eligible for limited English proficiency programs.

sponsored.t: Establishes the advanced coursework expansion incentive grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the advanced coursework expansion incentive grant program to school districts who offer advanced courses to economically disadvantaged students.

sponsored.t: Enacts the optometry freedom act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the optometry freedom act which prohibits a carrier or vision plan restricting an optometrist's choice of supply.

sponsored.t: Establishes catastrophe savings accounts
sponsored.sum: Establishes catastrophe savings accounts as a tax-free account to allow homeowners to save money to cover qualified catastrophe expenses.

sponsored.t: Limits certain regulations or orders promulgated by the superintendent related to term life insurance
sponsored.sum: Relates to term life insurance suitability information and the limiting of regulations or orders promulgated by the superintendent related thereto.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York insurance underwriting transparency act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York insurance underwriting transparency act; requires material changes to an insured's automobile or homeowners insurance to be explained in clear and useful language.

sponsored.t: Expands Medicaid coverage to include neuropsychological exams for dyslexia
sponsored.sum: Expands Medicaid coverage to include neuropsychological exams for dyslexia.

sponsored.t: Relates to prescription drug cost-sharing assistance
sponsored.sum: Authorizes insurance policies which provide coverage for prescription drugs where cost-sharing obligations are determined by category of prescription drugs to offer a program to insureds that utilizes rebates or discounts to lower an insured's cost-sharing for prescription drugs if the insured's cost-sharing under such program would be more favorable than the cost-sharing that would otherwise be applicable to the prescription drug.

sponsored.t: Relates to general hospital cost reports
sponsored.sum: Requires general hospitals to post publicly copies of their institutional cost reports.

sponsored.t: Enacts the safe housing transfer for domestic violence victims act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the safe housing transfer for domestic violence victims act; ensures safe housing transfers for domestic violence victims in public and private housing; requires landlord response within seven days of a relocation request.

sponsored.t: Creates an affordable housing insurance relief fund program
sponsored.sum: Creates an affordable housing insurance relief fund program to provide grants to eligible projects for reasonable and necessary commercial insurance expenses.
sponsored.fis: The fund shall provide financial assistance in an amount not to exceed three thousand dollars per income-restricted housing unit, and not to exceed two million dollars per eligible project annually. A request shall be made to the governor for an appropriation of fifty million dollars to establish and administer the fund for the purpose of mitigat- ing increased insurance costs impacting income-restricted housing devel- opments.

sponsored.t: Relates to procedures for the foreclosure of tax lien proceedings
sponsored.sum: Requires municipal tax collectors to hold a hearing after a tax lien sale to distribute funds to the former owner of such property.

sponsored.t: Includes urban farming within farm operations for purposes of agricultural districts
sponsored.sum: Includes urban farming within farm operations for purposes of agricultural districts.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "construction laborer insurance protection act (CLIPA)"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "construction laborer insurance protection act (CLIPA)"; requires every policy or contract of insurance issued to an owner, contractor or subcontractor performing the work of erection, demolition, repairing, altering, painting, or cleaning of a building, structure or edifice to provide coverage for bodily injury and death of workers.

sponsored.t: Provides additional tax exemptions for two qualified veterans living in the same household
sponsored.sum: Provides additional tax exemptions on qualifying residential real property where two or more qualified veterans live in the same household.

sponsored.t: Consolidates the licensing system for agents and brokers into a single producer license; repealer
sponsored.sum: Consolidates the licensing system for agents and brokers into a single producer license.

sponsored.t: Relates to pharmacy benefit management services and durable medical equipment
sponsored.sum: Expands pharmacy benefit management services to include the management or administration of benefits relating to durable medical equipment; defines "durable medical equipment"; relates to pharmacy or durable medical equipment provider audits by pharmacy benefit managers.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring providers to share electronic medical records with healthcare plans
sponsored.sum: Requires that a contract between an insurer and a hospital shall include a provision that provides for medical records requested by the insurer or its utilization review agent to be made available electronically by the hospital; limits the use of disclosed records.

sponsored.t: Improves transparency in the insurance claims process
sponsored.sum: Improves transparency in the insurance claims process; regulates insurance adjusting professionals; institutes licensing standards for insurance professionals; ensures timely responses to insurance claims; enhances policyholder protections.

sponsored.t: Relates to the veterans tuition awards program
sponsored.sum: Expands the veterans tuition awards program to allow the transfer of unused benefits to a spouse, survivor or child; defines terms.

sponsored.sum: Directs contracting state agencies to develop a growth plan in order to increase participation of minority- and women-owned businesses with respect to state contracts and subcontracts which includes an analyses of the use of discretionary buying.

sponsored.sum: Requires police officers to receive training instruction for crimes involving sexual assaults; requires training for child protective services workers in certain instances.

sponsored.sum: Prohibits unfair residential real estate service agreements which are certain service agreements which are not to be performed within two years following the time such agreement is entered into.

sponsored.sum: Excludes violations in a cooperative housing development containing Mitchell-Lama housing with no fewer than ten thousand units from bus operation-related traffic regulations.

sponsored.sum: Relates to extending the exemption from filing requirements only with respect to rates and policy forms to businesses underwritten and transacted from an office outside this state.

sponsored.sum: Establishes an online insurance verification system for motor vehicle insurance; requires insurers to provide necessary information.

sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Mt. Vernon to establish a school speed zone demonstration program; authorizes installation in no more than twenty school speed zones in such city.

sponsored.sum: Authorizes a court issuing a non-family offense temporary order of protection or an order of protection to direct that such order be filed with the computerized registry for orders of protection and warrants, if it is necessary to fulfill the purposes of such order; directs the superintendent of state police to include such orders on computerized registry.

sponsored.t: Relates to training police officers on how to respond to situations involving individuals with autism spectrum disorder and other developmental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to training police officers on how to respond to situations involving individuals with autism spectrum disorder and other developmental disabilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to indexing fixed amounts and clarifying compliance
sponsored.sum: Relates to indexing fixed amounts and clarifying compliance with respect to life insurance agents.

sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Mount Vernon to impose a hotel and motel tax of 5.875%.

sponsored.sum: Increases the tax on deeds in the city of Mount Vernon to 1 1/2 percent.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for speech therapy for stuttering
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for speech therapy for stuttering.

sponsored.t: Provides for the issuance of pet insurance
sponsored.sum: Provides for the issuance of pet insurance that provides coverage for accidents and illnesses of pets.

sponsored.sum: Relates to contractual liability insurance policies; provides that each provider may maintain a maximum of five service contract reimbursement insurance policies insuring its service contracts actively offered.

sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions relating to medical malpractice insurers until December 31, 2028.

sponsored.t: Permits certain licensed athletic trainers to practice in New York State if they are licensed to practice in another state, territory or country
sponsored.sum: Permits certain licensed athletic trainers who are licensed to practice in another state, territory or country to provide athletic training services to athletes and team personnel at a discrete sanctioned team sporting event or performance in this state.

sponsored.t: Relates to policies and procedures for when a child less than eighteen years old is arrested
sponsored.sum: Directs the superintendent of state police, in consultation with the office of children and family services, shall develop, maintain and disseminate to all members of the state police written policies and procedures, regarding child-sensitive arrest practices.

sponsored.t: Relates to high deductible health plans and health savings accounts
sponsored.sum: Relates to cost sharing requirements for high deductible health plans and health savings accounts.

sponsored.sum: Requires the superintendent to promulgate regulations which provide standardized definitions for commonly used terms and phrases in certain insurance policies.

sponsored.sum: Requires rates paid for rehabilitation and opioid treatment be pursuant to certain fee schedules published by the office of addiction services and supports.

sponsored.sum: Relates to health care plans for step therapy protocol; amends effective date to January 1, 2026.

sponsored.sum: Requires the installation of smoke detectors in residential buildings with common spaces shared between three or more dwelling units and that such smoke detectors can be heard in such common spaces.
